name: session-relay
description: Stop a Claude Code CLI session on one machine and resume the same conversation on another (macOS <-> WSL2 Ubuntu), via any rclone remote.

rclone_remote.title: rclone remote
rclone_remote.description: rclone remote that stores relayed sessions, including the trailing colon, e.g. r2: or b2:my-bucket. Configure it first with `rclone config` on every machine.

base_path.title: Base path on the remote
base_path.description: Folder under the remote where sessions are stored.
